TRANSFERINSTRUMENTANDNOTICE OF RESTRICTIONS TRANSFER OFDEVELOPMENT RIGHTSANDNOTICE OFRESTRICTIONS PURSUANT TOSECTION 81-74 OFTHE ZONINGRESOLUTION OF THECITY OF NEW YORK NOTICE, made as of this M_day of October, 2011, by and between BROADHURST THEATRE, LLC, a New York limited liability company, with an address at 234 West 44th Street, New York, New York 10036 (the “Theater Owner"), and AREP FIFTY- SEVENTH LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with an address at 505 Park Avenue, 21" Floor, New York, New York 10022 ("Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,theTheaterOwneristheowneroftheBroadhurstTheaterwhichis located on the real property in the City, County and State of New York designated as Lot 11 of Block 1016 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and by the street address 235West 44th Street, New York, New York (the “Theater") (the land underlying the Theater, the “Land," and the Land and the Theater, the “Premises"). The Land is more particularly described in Exhibit A hereto; and WHEREAS, Theater Owner operates the Theater as a theater; and WHEREAS, Theater Owner is the owner of all the real property described in Exhibit A (such real property, the “Real Property", which comprises a single zoning lot (the "Theater Zoning Lot"); and WHEREAS, the Real Property is located in the Theater Subdistrict, as such term is defined in Section 81-70 et seq. of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the "Zoning Resolution"), and the Theater is designated in Section 81-742 of the Zoning Resolution as a Listed Theater; and WHEREAS, the Theater Owner seeks to transfer certain Excess FloorArea leased by Purchaser designated as Lot 44 of Block 1009 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and by the street address 120 West 57h Street, New York, New York (the “Receiving Site"). The Receiving Site is more particularly described in Exhibit B hereto; and WHEREAS, the Receiving Site is located within the Theater Subdistrict, as such term is defined in Section 81-71 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, such a transfer of development rights from a Listed Theater within the Theater Subdistrict to another site is govermed by the provisions of Section 81-74 of the Zoning Resolution; and

WHEREAS,the transfer of theExcessFloorAreaDevelopmentRightsfrom the Theater Zoning Lot to theReceiving Site requires a certification by the City Planning Commission ("CPC") pursuant to Section 81-744 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Certification"); and WHEREAS,Purchaser desires to receive from Theater Owner, and Theater Owner desires to transfer to Purchaser, the Excess Floor Area Development Rights. NOW,THEREFORE,in consideration of themutual covenants and agreements herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows: “Floor Area Development Rights”shall mean the development rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop the zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) determined (A) by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio (as hereinafter defined) for structures in the zoning district or districts in which such zoning lot is located, (B) by the inclusion of any available “bonus” floor area, and (C) by the further inclusion of any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of The City of NewYork from time to time. “Excess Floor Area DevelopmentRights”shall mean18,075 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Theater Zoning Lot. “use”and “bulk” shall have the meanings set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. Theater Owner hereby conveys, assigns, transfers and sets over to Purchaser the Excess Floor Area Development Rights solely for the use and benefit, in perpetuity, of the ReceivingSite. This conveyance is made subject to the trust fund provisions of Section 13 of the New York Lien Law. At the request and expense of Purchaser, Theater Owner covenants that it will execute or procure any further necessary assurances of its rights to make the within transfer. Notice is hereby given that this transfer (a) irrevocably restricts the available floor area appurtenant to the Theater Zoning Lot by reducing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant thereto by 18,075 square feet of floor area, and (b) benefits the Receiving Site by irrevocably increasing the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant thereto by 18,075 square feetoffloor area. Theater Owner covenants that at no time shall any building, buildings or improvements be situated on the Theater Zoning Lot which would have a floor area in excess of the floor area permitted thereon pursuant to the Zoning Resolution or any amendments thereof.
